title: Maps from bounded-above projective complexes to acyclic complexes are null-homotopic
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], let $P^\bullet$ be a bounded-above cochain complex of projective objects, and let $L^\bullet$ be an acyclic cochain complex. Every morphism of complexes $P^\bullet\to L^\bullet$ is homotopic to zero.
